meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

copy.tagline: 将个人微信接入你的应用,扫码即可收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想给项目加上个人微信消息收发能力。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your app to personal WeChat via official API for messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs personal WeChat messaging.

howto.what: 给 Claude 接入个人微信：通过腾讯官方 iLink Bot API 长轮询收发消息，用手机扫码登录，不需要 webhook 地址，也不用付费 token。登录后还需把频道接到一个 agent 组，它才会回复消息。
howto.when: 当你需要给 Claude 添加个人微信频道时使用：在 .env 里设 WECHAT_ENABLED=true、重启服务、用手机扫二维码登录。收到消息前还要把频道接到某个 agent 组。

say.text: 用 add-wechat 把个人微信接入，说明扫码登录的步骤
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并构建

say.text: 微信日志报 session expired，登录过期了怎么办
say.note: 提示删除 auth.json 并重启重扫

say.text: 把刚给机器人发消息的那个微信联系人接到我的 agent 组
say.note: 运行 wire-dm.ts 完成接线

howto.what_en: Adds a personal WeChat channel to Claude via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. It long-polls for messages and logs in by QR scan — no webhook URL and no paid token. After login, wire it to an agent group before it replies.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to add a personal WeChat channel: set WECHAT_ENABLED=true in .env, restart the service, and scan the QR code with your phone. Wiring it to an agent group is also needed.

say_en.text: Use add-wechat to connect my personal WeChat and show me the scan steps
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, builds

say_en.text: WeChat says session expired in the logs — what do I do?
say_en.note: Delete data/wechat/auth.json and restart to re-scan

say_en.text: Wire the WeChat contact who just messaged the bot to my agent group
say_en.note: Runs wire-dm.ts to create the wiring
